tools.name: gsc_search_performance
tools.description: Query Google Search Console search performance data. Returns clicks, impressions, CTR, and position for a site. Supports filtering by query, page, device, or country and grouping by multiple dimensions.

site_url.description: Site URL in GSC format, e.g. 'sc-domain:example.com' or 'https://example.com/'. Uses config default if omitted.

dimensions.description: Dimensions to group results by. Default: ['query'].

filter_query.description: Filter results to queries containing this string.

filter_page.description: Filter results to this page URL (exact match).

filter_device.description: Filter results to this device type.

filter_country.description: Filter results to this country (ISO 3166-1 alpha-3, e.g. 'USA').

row_limit.description: Max rows to return. Default 100, max 25000.

tools.name: gsc_striking_distance
tools.description: Find queries ranking in positions 4–20 (striking distance / low-hanging fruit). These are the best candidates for quick ranking improvements. Results sorted by impressions descending.

site_url.description: Site URL in GSC format, e.g. 'sc-domain:example.com'. Uses config default if omitted.

min_position.description: Minimum average position to include. Default: 4.

max_position.description: Maximum average position to include. Default: 20.

tools.name: gsc_traffic_drop
tools.description: Compare two date periods and identify pages or queries with significant traffic drops. Useful for diagnosing algorithm updates, technical issues, or content decay.

site_url.description: Site URL in GSC format, e.g. 'sc-domain:example.com'. Uses config default if omitted.

dimension.description: Group by page or query. Default: 'page'.

min_drop_percent.description: Minimum click drop percentage to flag (e.g. 20 = 20% drop). Default: 20.

min_clicks_previous.description: Minimum clicks in previous period to include (filters out low-traffic noise). Default: 5.

row_limit.description: Max dropped items to show. Default: 25.

tools.name: gsc_url_inspection
tools.description: Inspect a URL's indexing status in Google Search Console. Returns crawl date, indexing verdict, canonical URL, rich results eligibility, and mobile usability status.

url.description: The exact URL to inspect (must be within the site property).

site_url.description: Site URL in GSC format, e.g. 'sc-domain:example.com'. Uses config default if omitted.

tools.name: gsc_sitemap_list
tools.description: List all sitemaps submitted to Google Search Console for a site, including their status, URL counts, and last submission date.

site_url.description: Site URL in GSC format, e.g. 'sc-domain:example.com'. Uses config default if omitted.

tools.name: gsc_brand_nonbrand
tools.description: Split search traffic into branded and non-branded query segments. Returns aggregated clicks, impressions, CTR, and position for each segment, plus top queries.

site_url.description: Site URL in GSC format, e.g. 'sc-domain:example.com'. Uses config default if omitted.

brand_terms.description: Brand terms to match against queries (case-insensitive). Any query containing one of these is classified as branded. Example: ['acme', 'acmecorp'].

show_top_queries.description: Include top 10 branded and non-branded queries. Default: true.

tools.name: request_indexing
tools.description: Ask Google to index (or re-index) a single URL via the Google Indexing API. Sends a URL_UPDATED notification and returns the confirmation with notifyTime. Requires the Indexing API scope — re-run auth if you get a 403.

url.description: The URL to request indexing for (must be publicly accessible).

tools.name: request_indexing_batch
tools.description: Ask Google to index (or re-index) a batch of URLs via the Google Indexing API. Accepts up to 200 URLs (daily quota limit). Sends URL_UPDATED notifications in series with a small delay between requests and returns a report of successes and failures.

urls.description: Array of URLs to request indexing for (max 200, the daily API quota).

delay_ms.description: Milliseconds to wait between requests (default: 10). Google recommends staying under 100 req/s.

tools.name: bing_keyword_research
tools.description: Research keywords using Bing Webmaster Tools. Returns monthly search volume (impressions) for a keyword and a list of related keywords. This keyword data is exclusive to Bing and not available in Google Search Console.

site_url.description: Your site URL in Bing Webmaster Tools, e.g. 'https://example.com/'. Uses config default if omitted.

tools.name: bing_crawl_health
tools.description: Get crawl statistics and crawl issues from Bing Webmaster Tools. Shows crawl frequency, error counts by type (4xx, timeouts, DNS failures, blocked), and a list of specific crawl problems.

site_url.description: Your site URL in Bing Webmaster Tools, e.g. 'https://example.com/'. Uses config default if omitted.

show_issues.description: Include specific crawl issues. Default: true.

max_issues.description: Max crawl issues to show. Default: 20.

tools.name: bing_url_inspection
tools.description: Inspect a URL's indexing and crawl status in Bing Webmaster Tools. Returns HTTP status, indexing state, crawl date, page title, link counts, and whether the URL is blocked.

site_url.description: Your site URL in Bing Webmaster Tools, e.g. 'https://example.com/'. Uses config default if omitted.

tools.name: bing_sitemap_list
tools.description: List all sitemaps submitted to Bing Webmaster Tools for a site, including URL counts, indexed counts, errors, and last crawl time.

site_url.description: Your site URL in Bing Webmaster Tools, e.g. 'https://example.com/'. Uses config default if omitted.
